title: MLS system audit #3 — lock path, settlement, archive plane, concurrency, cross-layer

CRITICAL_FINDING_lock_freshness.issue: execution_ready required freshness_basis==provider AND age<=600s (V9.1 eval F6). Kalshi publishes NO quote-update timestamp: updated_time tracks the market DEFINITION and measured ~108,880s (~30h) stale on an ACTIVE two-sided market (0.26/0.25, volume ~43k, OI ~39k). Gate was unsatisfiable.
CRITICAL_FINDING_lock_freshness.blast_radius: execution_ready permanently False -> risk.market_gate rejected EVERY paper signal NOT_EXECUTION_READY -> slate.py classified EVERY fixture EXECUTION_NOT_READY. Saturday would have produced locks and predictions but ZERO paper-trading evidence, looking like correct fail-closed behaviour.
CRITICAL_FINDING_lock_freshness.fix: lock policy mls-lock-v1 -> mls-lock-v2: freshness measured on OUR capture clock, basis recorded as capture_time, provider timestamp retained per quote for audit. Verified against the REAL Kalshi book: execution_ready False->True, status complete, 62/62 priced. Prod paper_execution_ready now true.
CRITICAL_FINDING_lock_freshness.coverage_gap: nothing pinned the v1 rule — 475 tests passed with the platform core purpose disabled. 3 regression tests added, 1 fails without the fix.

lock_path_exercised_for_real: capture_lock_snapshot run against the LIVE Kalshi book (first time outside mocks): status complete, 11/11 events, contracts_expected 62, quotes_written 62, all priced, 933 depth rows, failure_reason None.

honest_note: Rounds 1-3 each found real defects in fully-green code. The recurring shape: a correct implementation of an assumption that was never checked against the provider reality. This is risk reduction, not a bug-free certification.
